title: How to fix an HP printer that’s not printing
description: A practical checklist to help you find out what is holding up your print queue.
content:
Start with the basics
Check that your printer is powered on and has paper. Look at the display for a specific error message. Never open powered internal components.

Check your print queue
Open your computer’s printer settings, select the correct printer and cancel stuck jobs. Confirm it is not set to pause or work offline.

Check the connection
For USB printers, check the cable connection. For wireless printers, confirm the computer and printer are on the same network.

When to ask for help
If the problem continues, note the printer model and error code and contact Pinterok. We provide independent repair services and are not affiliated with HP.

title: Canon printer error codes, explained
description: What to do when your printer display has something to tell you.
content:
Find the exact code
Write down the full error code and model number. Codes vary by model, so check the manual supplied with your printer or the manufacturer’s support page.

Look for simple causes
Check for empty paper trays, an open cover or a cartridge that is not seated correctly. Follow your model’s instructions and do not force stuck parts.

Get expert help
Persistent errors may need a technician. Share the code with Pinterok so we can help assess the next step. We are an independent provider, not affiliated with Canon.

title: Why does your printer keep going offline?
description: Reconnect your printer and get your home office back on track.
content:
Check the network
Make sure your printer and computer are connected to the same WiFi network. A guest network may isolate devices.

Restart and reconnect
Save your work, restart the printer and check its network status. Consult the device manual before resetting any network settings.

Select the right printer
Remove stuck print jobs and choose the correct printer in your system settings. Multiple saved copies of the same printer can cause confusion.

Still offline?
Pinterok can help with connectivity and setup for homes and offices. Tell us your printer model and what you have tried.
